# Estes Painting Company of Birmingham

> Residential and commercial painting contractor serving greater Birmingham, Alabama since 1999. Owner: Mike Estes. Phone: (205) 918-8982. Hoover office: 2256 Rocky Ridge Rd #102, Hoover, AL 35216, (205) 350-3501. Free estimates.

## Services
- Residential painting (interior and exterior): https://www.estespainting.com/residential/services.html
- Commercial painting (offices, apartments, condo associations, schools, churches, restaurants, warehouses): https://www.estespainting.com/commercial/services.html
- Carpentry (wood rot repair, wainscot, crown molding, chair rail, handrails, built-ins): https://www.estespainting.com/carpentry/services.html
- Decks (new wood and Trex decks, replacement, repair, staining): https://www.estespainting.com/deck/builder.html
- Window and door replacement, kitchen and bathroom remodeling: https://www.estespainting.com/window-door/replacement.html
- Specialty: painted brick, painted stucco, faux finishing, texture coating, clear coating and staining, ceiling textures, power washing, garage floor coatings

## Service area
Birmingham, Greystone, Homewood, Hoover, Inverness, Mountain Brook and Vestavia Hills, Alabama.

## Key facts
- Founded 1999 by Mike Estes; owner-operated
- 15 professionals on staff, including a carpenter; crane, bucket trucks and scaffolding for tall buildings
- Licensed, maximum liability insurance, background checks and drug screens on all painters
- 85% of business comes from customer referrals
- Free, no-obligation estimates: https://www.estespainting.com/estimate.html
